page.layout: One printed page, number 41, with running head centred at top. One column of running text. Right margin: one note beside "Qua-" (1 Sam. 15. 22.), and a stray mark "2" lower down. Below the text: one footnote line ("Arcam"). Left edge: fragment of the facing page, not transcribed.

main_text.l: olenne eft) iftam excogitasse inobedientiæ
suæ satisfactionem & quasi [illegible, ~12 letters] ne quid nobis
molestiæ creet hæc exceptiuncula, observandum
t[?], ubi accedit inobedientiæ hypocrisis, non tàm au-
ri crimen quàm duplicari. Fuisse quidem Saul-
m duplicis culpæ reum nullius dubito; Inobedien-
ia & Simulationis: ut interim taceam tertiam il-
am utriusque radicem, Mandatum[?] affectum. Di-
stincta utique sunt duo ista peccata; & nec natu-
ra, nec tempore conjuncta. Non naturâ; quia po-
est esse alterutrum sine altero: non tempore; præ-
sit enim aliquandiu inobedientia, accessit postea
nova occasione simulatio. Id quod ex ipsis
[?]amuelis verbis non obscurè colligi potest: qui
dissimulata prorsus Regis simulatione, unam ejus
obedientiam severè admodum & acriter reprehen-
it. 'Potior est, inquit, obedientia sacrificio. Qua-
[?]diceret, Quid mihi sacrificia narras; quæ, seu
ona fide ante intenderis, seu nunc demum excu-
indæ inobedientiæ tuæ obtendas, perinde est ad
bsequii rationem. Mos erat gerendus præcipienti
Domino, & quod abs illo in mandatis acceperas
rompte & sine disceptatione adimplendum. Sed
nim utcunque se habeat res Saulina, illud inte-
[?]im certum est, Uzzam (cujus historia, 2. Sam. 6.
scripta legitur) non simulatè, sed bonâ fide &
ia admodum intentione sacro vasi manum admo-
isse ; ne scilicet excuteretur in terram Arca fœde-
is, (quod erat tunc temporis & sub œconomiâ
eteris Testamenti tremendum divinæ præsentiæ
ymbolum) cum succusso vehementius quo ve-
hebatur plaustro velut mox ruitura nutaret. Le-
viculà hæc (ut quibusdam visò) sed importuna te-
meritate, etsi nulla subesset mala mens, commeru-
it tamen, ut magnâ spectante populi coronâ im-
missæ divinitus mortis præsenti supplicio afficere-
ur. Edixerat nimirum jamdiu Dominus Jehova

page.notes: Greek phrase after "quasi" is not legible enough to read; left as illegible. Left edge clipped: first letters of several lines (for example "olenne", "t,", "ri", "ia", "bsequii", "rompte", "eteris") are fragments. "Mandatum" uncertain (printed form may read "Mandanum"). The footnote "Arcam" is short and its mark is unclear. A small stray "2" stands in the right margin beside "ymbolum" with no note text. Possible "[?]im" at start of the line after "inte-" (interim expected). Long s normalised to s; u/v and i/j adjusted per the rules.
